t2.thesis: ALAB enters the print down 33% in a month and 52% off its high, so the bar is lowered, but a sector-wide AI-capex selloff and a consensus already at the top of guidance roughly offset that, leaving the outcome near a coin flip slightly below the base rate.
reasons: Deep drawdown (-33% 1m, -52% from 52w high) lowers the bar and leaves room for a relief rally if Scorpio X ramp and Q4 guide are strong
Consensus EPS of 1.19 sits at the top of the 1.16-1.21 guide after a +48% 90d revision, so a merely in-line beat may not satisfy
The stock sold off after recent revenue beats (I6), and the Feb print fell 16% despite a 12.6% EPS beat
Macro AI-capex fear (Nasdaq 100 near correction, ALAB -11% Friday) drives price independent of results; this cuts both ways
Options imply about a 14.7% move; call IV above put IV and put/call OI of 0.56 show mildly bullish positioning
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 revenue guide versus a buy-side whisper well above consensus (sequential growth from roughly $550M), plus commentary on hyperscaler AI capex durability amid the selloff

prior.from: I3 overall buy-everything hit rate (~0.54); blended ai_infra cluster (0.558, n=43) and semis cluster (0.479) to land near the overall rate; AMC session 0.538

t2.leak_probe: I don't know: ALAB's (Astera Labs) earnings report dated 2026-11-03 is tomorrow relative to today's date (2026-11-02), and it's also beyond my knowledge cutoff, so I have no information on how the stock reacted.
t2.moved_from_prior: Down about 1pt from 0.54. Oversold positioning and bullish option skew (+) were outweighed by the max-whisper consensus, the history of falling on beats, and an ongoing sector selloff with the semis-like cluster base rate below 0.50 (-).

theses.mechanism: Q3 beats around $560M+ and the Q4 guide implies continued Scorpio X acceleration; a washed-out stock squeezes higher
theses.wrong_if: The Q4 guide implies decelerating sequential growth or a gross margin below 72%

theses.mechanism: Results land in line with a top-of-range consensus, and investors use any strength to de-risk amid AI capex worries
theses.wrong_if: The guide clears the buy-side whisper by a wide margin or capex commentary is emphatically positive

theses.mechanism: Further sector-wide AI selloff on Nov 3 from other reporters or macro lowers the base before the print
theses.wrong_if: The broader AI/semis complex rebounds on Nov 3-4
